annotations.title: RFM customer segmentation: Champions, At Risk, Cannot Lose Them... with actions

description: RFM customer segmentation: Champions, At Risk, Cannot Lose Them... with actions — Offline RFM (recency, frequency, monetary) analysis. Send customers=id:recency_days:frequency:monetary;... OR raw orders=customer:YYYY-MM-DD:amount;... with optional as_of=YYYY-MM-DD (5-5000 customers). Scores each customer 1-5 on R, F and M by quintile within your list, assigns the standard 10 segments (Champions, Loyal Customers, Potential Loyalists, New Customers, Promising, Need Attention, About To Sleep, At Risk, Cannot Lose Them, Hibernating), and returns a segment summary with customer and revenue share, averages and a recommended marketing action, revenue at risk, and the top customers by score (limit=, default 100). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_rfm
